<noinclude><pagequality level="3" user="BRPXQZME" />{{running header|392|{{asc|THE SHIH KING.}}|{{smaller|{{asc|DECADE I.}}}}}}{{rule}}</noinclude>the {{tooltip|Wei|Wèi}},{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
The centre of all the states,{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
The resort of the lower people.

God said to king Wăn,{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
'I am pleased with your intelligent virtue,{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
Not loudly proclaimed nor pourtrayed,{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
Without extravagance or changeableness,{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
Without consciousness of effort on your part,{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
In accordance with the pattern of God.'{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
God said to king Wăn,{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
'Take measures against the country of your foes.{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
Along with your brethren,{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
Get ready your scaling ladders,{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
And your engines of onfall and assault,{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
To attack the walls of {{tooltip|''Kh''ung|Chóng}}<ref>[[w:zh:崇國|''Kh''ung]] was a state, in the present district of [[w:Huyi District|Hû]], department [[w:Xi'an|Hsî-an]], [[w:Shaanxi|Shen-hsî]]. His conquest of ''Kh''ung was an important event in the history of [[w:King Wen of Zhou|king Wăn]]. He moved his capital to it, advancing so much farther towards the east, nearer to the domain of [[Portal:Shang dynasty|Shang]]. According to [[Author:Sima Qian|Sze-mâ ''Kh''ien]] the marquis of ''Kh''ung had slandered the lord of [[w:Predynastic Zhou|''K''âu]], who was president of the states of the west, to [[w:King Zhou of Shang|''K''âu-hsin]], the king of Shang, and our hero was put in prison. His friends succeeded in effecting his deliverance by means of various gifts to the tyrant, and he was reinstated in the west with more than his former power. Three years afterwards he attacked the marquis of ''Kh''ung.</ref>.'

The engines of onfall and assault were (at first) gently plied,{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
Against the walls of ''Kh''ung high and great;{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
Captives for the question were brought in, one after another;{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
The left ears (of the slain) were taken leisurely<ref>So far the siege was prosecuted slowly and, so to say, tenderly, [[w:King Wen of Zhou|Wăn]] hoping that the enemy would be induced to surrender without great sacrifice of life.</ref>.{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
He had sacrificed to God and to the Father of War<ref name="p392_3">The sacrifice to God had been offered in ''K''âu, at the commencement of the expedition; that to the Father of War, on the army's arriving at the borders of ''Kh''ung. We can hardly tell who is intended by the Father of War. [[Author:Zhu Xi|''K''û Hsî]] and others would require the plural 'Fathers,' saying the sacrifice was to [[w:Yellow Emperor|Hwang Tî]] and [[w:Chiyou|''Kh''ih Yû]], who are found engaged in hostilities far back in the</ref>,{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
Thus seeking to induce<noinclude><!--¶-->
